title: Thus Spoke Zarathustra
author: Friedrich Wilhelm Nietzsche
description: A landmark work of philosophy and of literature, Thus Spoke Zarathustra is the fullest expression of Nietzche's belief that "the object of mankind should lie in its highest individuals."
